pr_title: fix(es/decorators): Fix init order of `2022-03` impl
pr_body:
**Description:**
Fix the order of initialization for 2022-03 decorators.
TBH the [proposal](https://github.com/tc39/proposal-decorators) isn't very clear on how `init` is executed for [auto-accessor](https://github.com/tc39/proposal-decorators) decorator


**Related issue:**

 - Closes #9669

issue_context.title: [Bug] 2022-03 decorator initialise class instance in wrong order
comments:
have a solution
check if `this` is used in any filed initialisation, find the first one, for example `value = this.getNumber()`
if found: replace `this` with `_initProto(this)` (make sure _initProto returns `this`), so the code will become `value =(_initProto(this)).getNumber()`
if not found: use `inject_after_super`

then run es2022 pass as usual

I will try create a pr
